description: Admin category management for top-level categories and subcategories. Adds an admin controller api/admin/categories (list with parent info, create with optional ParentCategoryId + server-derived slug + optional ImageUrl, update, and delete that returns 409 when the category has children or products), plus a new Angular admin Categories page (sidebar link + route) with a parent picker. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-004; depends only on FEAT-001 being in place for a clean build base.
steps: Add src/Shop.DAL/ViewModels/AdminCategoryViewModels.cs: CategoryUpsertRequest { [Required] Name, Description?, ImageUrl?, ParentCategoryId? } and AdminCategoryListItemVM { Id, Name, Slug, Description?, ImageUrl?, ParentCategoryId?, ParentName?, int ProductCount, int ChildCount }.

Add src/Shop.Api/Controllers/Admin/AdminCategoriesController.cs ([ApiController], [Authorize], [Route("api/admin/categories")], inject IRepoWrapper + IMapper). GET: load all categories including Parent/Children/Products counts (project to AdminCategoryListItemVM; include ParentName and the child/product counts). POST: create a Category, derive Slug server-side (reuse a private Slugify like AdminProductsController's), set ParentCategoryId from the request (null => top-level), set ImageUrl, IsDemoData=false, Save. PUT {id:int}: load-then-update Name/Description/ImageUrl/ParentCategoryId, re-derive slug, 404 when missing. DELETE {id:int}: 404 when missing; return 409 Conflict (ApiResponse.Fail(..., 409)) with a clear message when the category has any Children or any Products; otherwise delete + Save.

If a projection resolver is awkward inline, add the counts via the query (e.g. .Include(c => c.Children) and a product count via _repo._Product.Query().Count(p => p.CategoryId == c.Id)) — match the existing controller style (CategoriesController / AdminProductsController). No AutoMapper write map is required for Category since the controller sets fields explicitly; a read map is optional.

Frontend AdminService (client/src/app/core/services/admin.service.ts): add getAdminCategories(), createCategory(body), updateCategory(id, body), deleteCategory(id) hitting admin/categories (use postEnvelope/the delete envelope where the UI needs the 409 message).

Add the admin Categories page client/src/app/features/admin/admin-categories/admin-categories.component.{ts,html,css} following the admin-products/admin-discounts pattern (standalone, CommonModule + FormsModule). List top-level categories and subcategories (show parent name), an inline create/edit form with a parent picker (dropdown of top-level categories, blank = top-level) and an optional image URL, and a delete button that surfaces the server 409 message when the category has children/products.

Register the route: in client/src/app/app.routes.ts add a child route { path: 'categories', loadComponent: () => import('./features/admin/admin-categories/admin-categories.component').then(m => m.AdminCategoriesComponent) } under the /admin children block. Add a sidebar link Categories in client/src/app/features/admin/admin-shell/admin-shell.component.html (e.g. just after Products).
acceptance_criteria: Against the running API with an admin JWT: GET api/admin/categories returns the flat list with parent names and child/product counts; POST creates a top-level category and a subcategory (slug derived server-side); PUT updates one; DELETE on a category that has children or products returns 409 with a clear message, and DELETE on an empty category succeeds.
The admin shell shows a Categories link that routes to the working page.
verification: Runtime smoke: with the API running, obtain an admin token via POST api/auth/login (admin/Admin@12345) and exercise GET/POST/PUT/DELETE on api/admin/categories, confirming the 409-on-children/products behaviour; then STOP the API.
findings: Implemented admin category management. Backend: src/Shop.DAL/ViewModels/AdminCategoryViewModels.cs (CategoryUpsertRequest + AdminCategoryListItemVM) and src/Shop.Api/Controllers/Admin/AdminCategoriesController.cs ([ApiController]/[Authorize]/api/admin/categories) with GET (flat list incl. ParentName + ChildCount + ProductCount via grouped product-count query), POST (server-derived slug via a private Slugify matching AdminProductsController, optional ParentCategoryId + ImageUrl, IsDemoData=false), PUT (load-then-update, re-derive slug, 404 when missing), DELETE (404 when missing; 409 Conflict with clear message when the category has any Children or Products, otherwise delete+Save). No AutoMapper write map was added for Category (controller sets fields explicitly, per the feature note). Frontend: AdminService gained getAdminCategories/createCategory(postEnvelope)/updateCategory/deleteCategory; new standalone admin-categories page (ts/html/css) following the admin-products/admin-discounts pattern with a parent picker (blank = top-level), optional image URL, inline create/edit, and delete that surfaces the server 409 message; route 'categories' registered under /admin and a Categories sidebar link added after Products in admin-shell. Verification: backend build 0 errors / 0 warnings; ng build exit 0 (admin-categories-component chunk emitted). Runtime smoke against the running API with an admin JWT: GET returned the flat list (13 seeded rows); POST created a top-level ('smoke-top-level') and a subcategory ('smoke-sub-cat', parent resolved); PUT renamed + re-derived slug; DELETE on a parent with a child returned 409 with the clear message; DELETE on the empty subcategory then the now-empty parent both succeeded; DELETE on seeded category 1 (has products) returned 409. API stopped and demo DB deleted afterwards; scratch files removed. Note: the PowerShell tool integration was flaky (frequent -1 exit / empty output and one shell wedge from a foreground 'dotnet run'); worked around by redirecting to files, launching the API detached via Start-Process, and running the smoke script through a file. No Npgsql migration regenerated (SQLite demo path needs none); document the dotnet-ef command in README if the Postgres path is used.
